name: Resurrection The
overview: The resurrection is a foundational truth rooted in Old Testament prophecy and divine promise, as seen in Job's confident hope to see God in his flesh despite bodily decay, and in Psalms affirming that God will not abandon His Holy One to corruption or the grave. Isaiah and Ezekiel vividly depict the awakening of the dead, portraying resurrection as a powerful act of God that brings life from death and dry bones to renewed existence. These passages collectively affirm the certainty of resurrection as both a future hope and a demonstration of God's redeeming power.
